n: 48 In. 6.0 Cu. Ft. Legacy Dual Fuel Range With 7 Burner Gas Cooktop And 2 Electric Ovens In Stainless Steel
desc: The ZLINE 48 in. 6.0 cu. ft. Legacy Dual Fuel Range with 7 Burner Gas Cooktop and 2 Electric Ovens in Stainless Steel (RA48) pairs a powerful gas cooktop with 7 Italian-crafted burners, a large electric convection oven, and a small bake and broil oven with Landscape oven door window designs. With innovative features designed to enhance your kitchen’s capability, ZLINE Legacy Dual Fuel Ranges provide a professional culinary experience by pairing unmatched performance with timeless style.
hl: The Legacy Professional Range Series represents the foundation for ZLINE’s family-focused mission of attainable luxury
Optimize every meal with even heat distribution thanks to high-performance technology of a gas cooktop and a large electric convection oven
Industry-leading gas cooktop includes 7 hand-cast burners, including an expansive fish burner, with 1,000 - 18,000 BTUs of cooking power
ZLINE Legacy Series ranges feature a sleek Landscape oven door design that provides ample viewing space to ensure your dishes are perfectly cooked
A dual oven capacity of 6.0 cu. ft fits pans up to 23 in. or 9 in. wide for maximum space and convenience with everyday cooking
Perfectly sear meats and veggies with a pre-seasoned cast iron griddle that features superior heat retention and even heat distribution
